1.title: The Borrowed Bestiary
1.premise: A retired circus acrobat enters a living bestiary to find her missing performing partner. She can borrow one animal movement at a time, but must first earn that animal's cooperation.

2.title: The Mountain Circuit
2.premise: A disgraced courier enters a mountain racing circuit where competitors build their own movement skills.

3.title: The Winter Orchard
3.premise: An impatient apprentice gardener inherits a greenhouse on a wandering glacier. Growing magical fruit can change the small community's winter, but the plants respond to promises she actually keeps. Her absent teacher must remain physically absent throughout the first two chapters.

4.title: The Wandering Stall
4.premise: Two estranged siblings inherit a roaming market stall in a world where bargains can change personal abilities.
